osworld2.notesShort: Partial score (41.7% strict) on the 2026.08.08 release at 1080p, 500 steps, Opus 4.8 grader; the card states this run modified tasks and grading, so it is not directly comparable to official-settings rows. Self-reported.
Partial score (28.25% binary) at $15.70 per task for Simular's neuro-symbolic agent; self-reported by Simular, a benchmark co-author, against its quoted Opus 5 and Sol comparators.
Partial score on the 2026.08.08 offline subset under a latency simulation at roughly 40 minutes per task; maximum at any effort. Self-reported at launch.
Partial score (five-run first-attempt average at 1080p, 500 steps, Opus 4.8 grader); OpenAI's launch table separately lists 70.2% for its author-reproduced run on the offline subset. Self-reported.

Partial score (32.0% binary) at max reasoning effort on benchmark version 08.08 in Meta's GUI computer-control harness on a full Ubuntu desktop VM. Self-reported on the launch scorecard.
Partial score from the Opus 5 card's comparison table, which sources competitor scores from their release posts. Self-reported.
